about: 10CL016 M9K port-A mode bits (offline; rom2: zero-content builds of 7 layouts at X13_Y10 and X25_Y20). Cells [frame offset from F[X] (m9kpatch.F), byte offset from lutpos.ROW[Y].low, plane offset from ROW[Y].plane]; identical at both sites. One-hot width code; x36 (36x256) sets none of them. 9x512 uses the x18 code, as its content layout does (m9kpatch.LAYOUTS). 'not_x36' bits are set for every layout except 36x256. Other layout-dependent bits are routing of the differing address/data lines. Port B and RAM write modes not studied. Blind check at X13_Y4 and X25_Y12: width code 14/14; the not_x36 bits 8/14 as first written, 28/28 (all 4 sites) once the byte wrap (byte < 1: plane + 1, byte + 251/252) is applied to the -64 offsets; the wrap was added after the check.
silicon: 2026-11-23: a 9x512 ROM (x18 code) patched to the x9 code reads x9 word 2a+1 for counter address a (64/64 words; 1 of 4 pre-listed hypotheses): the extra address LSB reads 1, like other unconnected inputs.

ram_mode_candidates.about: rr:SITE:rom vs rr:SITE:ram (same pinned address counter; RAM adds wren = D, data = C). Bits relative to F[X] / ROW[y].low / plane, value in RAM mode. Identical at X13_Y10, X25_Y20 and (with byte wrap) X13_Y4; may include the write-enable/data input selects as well as the mode. Offline.
